name: Photoncytosis
shortDescription: A tiny organism feeds on screen light and grows while you work.
paragraphs: Photoncytosis is a desktop-life simulation in development. A soft-bodied creature takes the light and colour of your screen as its environment, turning everyday computer use into a habitat you can watch change.
Bright pixels on your screen feed the organism. Each cell holds its own energy, making the desktop more than a backdrop.
Inspect individual cells under the microscope, guide research in the mutation tree, and let the organism make your desktop its habitat.

highlights.title: Light becomes life.
highlights.text: Bright pixels on your screen feed the organism. Each cell holds its own energy, making the desktop more than a backdrop.

highlights.title: A body with different jobs.
highlights.text: Feeder, motor, and structural cells give a growing creature different ways to gather light, move, and hold together.

highlights.title: Your space is its habitat.
highlights.text: Watch the organism move across the desktop or keep it close to a chosen window. The world it responds to is the one on your screen.
